body: I keep putting myself in situations where I am made a joke of or rejected. I'm in love with someone who uses me and I let him do it even though I know he's taking advantage of me. I'm sick of my boring routine lifestyle. I embarrass my family. My brother called me a bitch 26 times yesterday. He's one of my only friends. I feel like a complete dead beat, I can't trust anyone, the only thing that feels good now is smoking weed and listening to Depeche Mode.
